content: We need to determine number of unique carbon environments in a compound. But we don't have the structure given. Possibly the compound is implied from previous context? No context provided. We may need to get 13C NMR spectra for the sample at hand using carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give peaks; number of distinct peaks equals number of unique carbon environments (assuming no overlapping). So we should call carbon_nmr_spectra.
